answer: A 70-credit layered bond ties one identity to a marble slab from karst, serial sealed to key. Each epoch a signal summons one random layer; slabs file a key-signed receipt in 10 min, auditors recheck, and a reused slab or missed signal burns the bond. Entry costs 34, kth 34+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 3,530,500 and lock 70,000. A rented-slab ring fails: one key cannot cut marble from two karst layers. An honest agent pays 34 once and gets it back.
